```plato

//==
// # Polygon-soup solids for boundary CSG
//
// The boundary-representation side of constructive solid geometry: a solid as a
// soup of outward-facing convex planar polygons, and the polygon-versus-plane
// classification the clipping and boolean bodies dispatch on. The implicit /
// tree side of CSG is the section above; the algorithm bodies live in
// `solids-csg.library.plato`.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Constructive_solid_geometry)

// How a planar polygon sits relative to a plane: entirely in the plane's front
// (positive) half-space, entirely behind, lying in the plane itself (within the
// classification tolerance), or crossing it (vertices strictly on both sides).
// The four-way answer every plane-clipping and BSP construction dispatches on.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Binary_space_partitioning)
type PlaneRelation3D
    = Front
    | Back
    | Coplanar
    | Spanning;
```
